workflow_runs.name: CPU optimization correctness
workflow_runs.display_title: Preserve DSP field placement and add render-thread CPU evidence

head_commit.message:
Preserve DSP field placement and add render-thread CPU evidence

Append cache bookkeeping after existing fields. On the measured GNU x86_64 layout, storage's generation counter fits eight bytes of tail padding, preserving the original storage/synth sizes and sampled DSP offsets. Cache behavior and processing cadence are unchanged.

Add optional Linux CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID reports alongside unchanged wall timing and PCM evidence. Strictly bind CPU sidecars to fixture/audio metadata and retain raw rounds, ranges and ratio-of-medians summaries. Earlier wall measurements were mixed and are retained for the final report.

Validation after a consistent rebuild: all 63 lifecycle PCM files identical to original engine, 59,702 modulation cases, and 4,854,298 assertions in 36 existing engine cases. All 80 Python tests, native sidecar smoke and 11 sidecar safety cases passed. Preserve the independently published native gallery parent.
